sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
♦ Wear the Amethyst and Rose Quartz Pencil Pendants around your neck using the 24K gold tone plated chain provided with it.
♦ Set a clear intention before wearing it, especially for love, calmness, emotional balance, protection, and positivity.
♦ You can wear both pendants together or keep one close depending on the energy you want to focus on.
♦ Clean the pendants and chain gently with a soft dry cloth whenever required.
♦ Avoid direct contact with water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals to maintain its shine and finish.

collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 This Amethyst and Rose Quartz Crystal Pencil Pendant Combo with Chain is really stylish and aesthetic, but according to crystal healing, the main reason to wear this combo is to bring love, calmness, emotional balance, and positive energy into your life.

Rose Quartz, often called the Crystal of Love, is cherished for attracting self-love, compassion, harmony, and positive relationships. It helps support emotional healing and brings a soft, loving energy around you. Amethyst, known as the All-Purpose Crystal, is believed to support peace, balance, clarity, protection, and relief from stress and anxiety. Together, these two crystals make a beautiful combo for anyone who wants to feel more loved, calm, balanced, and spiritually connected.

The combo comes with an 24K gold tone plated chain, so you can wear it directly without worrying about finding a matching one. The pencil pendant design gives it a modern and fashionable look, making it easy to wear as daily jewellery or as a meaningful accessory for special moments.

This is a handcrafted crystal jewellery combo, crafted by India’s biggest energy brand with attention to detail and quality. Each crystal passes through an authenticity check before it reaches you, ensuring a genuine and reliable crystal accessory.

Kindly note that images are just a graphical representation of crystals. Size, shape, and colour may vary at the time of delivery.

Disclaimer: Crystals are believed to support positive energy, healing, and intention, but they work best when combined with your own efforts, right actions, and consistent hard work. Results may vary from person to person.
